# Gracious Love Academy

Gracious Love Academy is a small CBC primary school in Jomoko, Thika, Kiambu County, Kenya. We offer education from PP1 through Grade 6 under the Kenyan Competency Based Curriculum (CBC) approved by KICD.

## About

Founded in 2023, Gracious Love Academy is committed to knowing each child. We maintain small class sizes so teachers can build real relationships, track individual progress, and communicate regularly with parents.

- **Location:** Jomoko, near Kingdom Seekers Church, Thika — behind SK Suites
- **Phone:** +254 727 345 438
- **WhatsApp:** https://wa.me/254727345438
- **Email:** graciousloveacademy23@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://graciousloveacademy-school-website.vercel.app/
- **Curriculum:** Competency Based Curriculum (CBC) — PP1, PP2, Grade 1–6

## Programs

### Early Years (PP1 & PP2)
Ages 4–6. Play-based learning with stories, songs, guided play, and gentle structure.

### Lower Primary (Grade 1–3)
Ages 6–9. Daily phonics, practical numeracy, creative arts, and individual progress checks.

### Upper Primary (Grade 4–6)
Ages 9–12. Subject-specific teaching, leadership opportunities, and preparation for junior secondary.

## Admissions Process

1. Book a visit
2. Tour the school and meet the teacher
3. Complete registration
4. Start date confirmed

## Fee Structure

- **PP1 & PP2:** KES 6,500 per term
- **Grade 1–3:** KES 7,500 per term
- **Grade 4–6:** KES 9,500 per term

Payment plans available. Download the full fee structure: https://graciousloveacademy-school-website.vercel.app/downloads/fee-structure-2026.pdf
